hero.title: Orchestrate your agent ecosystem.
hero.description: Connect agents, systems, tools, workflows and human approvals into coordinated enterprise processes.

why.title: Value comes from coordination, not isolation
why.body: Individual agents deliver point solutions. The enterprise value of AI emerges when agents, tools, data and human decisions are coordinated into end-to-end processes. Orchestration is what turns a collection of capabilities into a working system.

steps.title: Model the process
steps.description: Map the end-to-end workflow, decisions and approvals involved.

steps.title: Assign agents & tools
steps.description: Determine which agents and systems handle each step.

steps.title: Coordinate execution
steps.description: Run steps in sequence with hand-offs and human checkpoints.

steps.title: Monitor & adapt
steps.description: Observe outcomes and refine the orchestration over time.

items.title: Agent Orchestration
items.description: Coordinate multiple agents into coherent, end-to-end processes.

items.title: Tool Integration
items.description: Give agents controlled access to the systems they need to act.

items.title: Workflow Coordination
items.description: Sequence steps, hand-offs and dependencies reliably.

items.title: Human-in-the-Loop Design
items.description: Insert approvals and oversight where judgement matters.

items.title: Enterprise Connectivity
items.description: Connect orchestration to the systems where work happens.
